description: `<slot />` outlet that receives content placed directly between the component tags.
Markup inside `<slot>...</slot>` rendered when the parent provides nothing.
`<slot name="header" />`, targeted from the parent with `<template #header>`.
A slot that passes data back to the parent: `<slot :item="item" />` received as `#default="{ item }"`.
Object of slot functions provided by the parent; useful to check whether a slot was passed.
